existing_features.title: Remove the PDF export option from the Export tab. The CSV export option should remain. The PDF-related UI elements (button, description, limit indicator) must be fully removed from ExportTab.tsx. The usePdfExport hook and any print-related CSS in index.css may be left in place but must no longer be surfaced in the UI.

Fix the 'Save' project action in DashboardHeader. Investigate the saveProject mutation flow in ProjectContext.tsx and useQueries.ts (the backend save call), identify why saving fails, and correct it so that clicking Save successfully persists the current project to the backend and shows a success toast.

projectName: Remove PDF export option and fix Save project action
